title: Management Trainee - Restaurants

reasons.love: Partly commercial; much of the role is back-office support.
reasons.good_at: The JD asks for sales quota experience that facts.md does not evidence.
reasons.needs: Stable employer, but the JD names no development path.
reasons.paid: Estimate: the posting states no salary. about THB 30,000-40,000 per month. for a comparable Bangkok graduate role.

summary: Weak on pay and growth compared with the graduate programmes on the board.
jd_text: Minor Food is hiring for Management Trainee - Restaurants in Bangkok, Thailand. You will work with cross-functional teams, analyse sales and customer data, prepare weekly reports and present recommendations to managers. Requirements: bachelor's degree in any field (2026-2027 graduates welcome); good command of English and Thai; strong Excel; a team player who learns quickly. We offer structured training, mentoring and a clear career path.
